description: URL Bookmark Manager web application running on localhost:5000. A Flask-based application for bookmarking and checking the status of URLs. Provides CRUD operations for managing bookmarks with per-user session tracking.
notes: Application uses session cookies for user tracking (user UUID: randomly generated). Bookmarks are stored in session cookies. The /delete endpoint accepts query parameters for URL ID. Potential vulnerabilities include: IDOR in user bookmarks, session fixation, cookie manipulation, XSS in bookmark URLs.
